subject: Compiler directives
notes: kb/Work PB1352 (w67m): the one text-word scanner reads a whole compiler directive line (CompilerDirectiveLine.TryParse, preceded only by spaces per 7.3.3 SR2) as ONE TextWordKind.DirectiveLine element; ApplyReplacements never compares or rewrites it and writes back, on its own line, any directive line lying inside a matched span. COPY REPLACING (applied before the copybook's own DEFINE/IF lines are rendered) and REPLACE (before the TURN/PROPAGATE/PAGE stages) therefore leave every directive line unchanged. cite.py --check 7.3.4 OK 1).
